title: Create the AI workflow value ledger

title: Add handoff schema and consistency validation

outcome.result: New handoffs use schema 1 with stable identity and supersession metadata; a lightweight PowerShell validator checks required fields, local links, and artifact availability without migrating historical notes.
verification: Test-Handoffs.ps1 passed across 116 notes and 1 schema-1 note
93 unavailable legacy artifact references were reported as warnings

notes: The first patch missed exact README context, and the first validator run exposed a Windows PowerShell parameter-default incompatibility. Both failures changed the implementation before the passing run.

title: Version and bundle the CellSim metric dictionary

outcome.result: Defined 20 versioned herbivore Stat-Line metrics and made report schema 26 and manifest schema 2 identify and bundle the exact dictionary used.
verification: PowerShell parsers accepted all changed scripts
Dictionary JSON parsed with 20 complete metric entries
A one-seed 20-tick Unity experiment compiled and produced the new bundle
Test-CellSimArtifactBundle.ps1 returned VALID with matching report and dictionary hashes

notes: An initial source lookup used the wrong script folder and the first documentation patch assumed the wrong contract title; both were corrected. The verification run is diagnostic evidence, not a balance result.

title: Run and review EX-011 cross-biome/species transfer

outcome.result: The preregistered combined Faster Movement then Crowding Tolerance intervention increased final Deer population in all 20 development and all 5 held-out Open Range pairs; Josh accepted this bounded finding on 2026-09-17.
verification: All four experiment bundles passed artifact validation
Primary FPO was independently checked against population history
All 25 paired FPO deltas were positive
Human decision recorded as narrow acceptance

human_review.notes: Accepted bounded transfer evidence on 2026-09-17; no usefulness rating supplied.

notes: The exact time to first useful evidence, task completion time, friction totals, and review minutes were not captured. The task was evidence-ready on 2026-09-12; the later human decision was recorded on 2026-09-17 and is not included in elapsed-time estimates.
